name: Task files operations: backup beside the project, checked restore, verify, purge, proxy check
summary: Every admin.py backup mirrors projects/NAME/.task-files into backups/NAME.task-files: the bytes a record still names and every journal entry, each file re-hashed while it is copied (one that no longer matches its name is reported and not copied), incremental, and manifest.json written last; the status file records task_files {status, files, bytes, path}, and backup-copy carries the folder. restore-new checks every file and record against the manifest before placing any; a mismatch places none and ends with exit 3, and a backup without the folder restores as before and says so. admin.py task-files verify re-hashes what the records need (exit 1 on a mismatch, a wrong size or a missing file); task-files purge (operator allowlist, --dry-run, under the project lock, one audit line in .task-files/audit.jsonl) removes the bytes of withdrawn files, of files on tasks closed before a date, and orphans and temporary files older than a day, never a file a live record of another task needs, and marks each entry purged {by, at, reason} (listed as purged; download 410). task-files proxy-check --url sends one unsigned upload of the per-file limit through the public address: Orchestra's own 401 passes. An upload refused before its body was read is closed lingering (5 s, 64 MiB, at most 8 at once, beyond that at once), and a refused upload's discard waits at most 10 s for the lock and never replaces the refusal.
